item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/May/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure now over central China will edge closer to the coastal areas of southern China later tomorrow, and bring showers and thunderstorms to the region during the weekend. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon, the weather over southern China will improve and temperatures will fall slightly early next week. A southerly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week and bring a few showers to the region. It will be hot during the day.
